name: bodily
description: Bowel/bladder pressure simulation (1m tick), involuntary release, pee/poop/flush verbs, timed relief routines onto any target (toilet/ground/furniture/lying creature; poop drops legwear + squats 20-40s, pee 10s w/ male-stand/female-sit; farts (pressure-scaled) + plops + surface-varied pee-stream sound cues via bodily.sfx; NPCs yell when peed on and bystanders recoil at public elimination, which also emits bodily.publicRelief → indecent-exposure charge; toilets foul until flushed), toilet/sink use panels, and a `shower` verb (gated on a shower fixture) that fully cleans you — clothing/skin stains, dried fluid, and blood — leaving a brief cosmetic 'refreshed' badge. Stains + digestion loads stay engine (server/engine/bodily.js substrate).

flush.note: KNOWN GAP: requires a toilet in the zone (object_type='toilet' or flags.toilet); errors otherwise. Surfaced as an action-link inside the 'use toilet' panel, not on examine. (The `use toilet`/`use sink` panels are a tagless specializedAction that examine can't surface either — toilet/sink are not in examine's hardcoded object_type branches — but `use` is not a command so it cannot be logged here.)

shower.note: Requires a shower in the zone (object_type='shower' / flags.shower / name ~ 'shower'); errors otherwise. Surfaced as an action-link inside the 'use shower' panel. Strips clothing_contamination + soiled_state + ejaculate_state + covered_in_blood (a superset of MIS `wash`, which leaves the bodily stains) and applies the cosmetic 'refreshed' effect.

soap.note: Declaration-only specializedAction on water_source furniture — a sink/shower advertises SOAP. The verb self-resolves the target and needs a carried item tagged soap.

scrub.note: Alias of soap; the sink surfaces the primary verb.
